messages:
alex: heads up — enterprise customer on Dedicated reporting streaming sessions that 'ghost' after ~30s: client sees a few partial chunks then connection drops, no final \"[DONE]\". they have bursty output, model=redwood/llama-30b-quant, session_id=cs-78a2. happening across nodes in eu-west-1. cURL they used attached below.

maria: do we know if traffic is fronted by ALB/NLB or direct ingress? also which client lib (python/js) and if they seen reconnects?

alex: ALB in front (internal), client=python requests+sseclient, they report automatic reconnects sometimes but state lost. curl repro i gave: `curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}\" \"https://dedicated-eu.example.com/v1/stream?session=cs-78a2\"` (with --no-buffer they still saw stop after ~30s).

jamal: 30s smells like proxy idle or health check. ALB default idletimeout 60s though. any proxies between ALB and pods? kube-proxy or nginx? also check TCP RST from LB. can we get a packet capture?

olivia: adding another angle — client-side TCP keepalive vs comment-ping. If client isn't sending any traffic for 30s and an intermediate proxy has a low idle threshold it may drop. SSE comment pings every 15s are usually our mitigation. do we have server-side comment-ping enabled for this Dedicated cluster?

alex: quick trace from customer (ingress->service->pod):
```
INGRESS  -> 200 -> 10.0.5.12:443
10.0.5.12 -> 200 -> svc-proxy
svc-proxy logs: downstream idle for 31s, closing conn
pod logs: no explicit error, only normal stream flush
```

maria: svc-proxy is our internal envoy sidecar? if so envoy has two relevant timeouts (idle_timeout, stream_idle_timeout) — default can be low in some configs. can you paste sidecar config?

alex: sidecar shows `stream_idle_timeout: 30s` in their helm values (yikes). customer helm override from 2yrs ago left it.

jamal: that's likely root cause — sidecar closing idle streams at 30s even if server will send next chunk later. short term workaround: bump stream_idle_timeout or enable regular comment pings from server. For long term we should detect config drift and warn on Dedicated deployments.

olivia: repro steps we should ask customer to run: 1) curl with `--no-buffer` and `-H 'Accept: text/event-stream'` 2) tcpdump on node: `tcpdump -i any host <client-ip> and port 443 -w /tmp/stream.pcap` 3) collect sidecar logs `kubectl -n <ns> logs <pod> -c envoy`. also include last-event-id from client if available.

alex: will ask for pcap and envoy logs, already requested. customer concerned about billing because streams are billed but are incomplete. they want either auto-reconnect w/ continuation or server-side dedupe so they don't double-bill.

maria: for billing question — we can add a note: if stream disconnects and client reconnects, we currently bill tokens emitted by the model regardless of client ACK; discuss with billing ops. tag billing if needed.

sre-bot: escalation created INC-2026: Dedicated streaming ghosting — assigned to eng-ml & eng-sre. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026 :rotating_light:

jamal: suggested short-term mitigation steps for support to offer customer: 1) set `stream_idle_timeout: 0` or >=120s in sidecar 2) enable server comment pings at 15s: `
// example: send ":\n" every 15s on SSE connection
` 3) enable TCP keepalive on client with interval < 30s 4) open ticket with infra to audit idle timeouts across Dedicated fleets.

alex: customer agreed to try bumping sidecar timeout and we'll request pcap. i'll coordinate a call. thanks all. :thumbsup:
